title: helianthemum oelandicum subsp. incanum
intro: Helianthemum oelandicum subsp. incanum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Cistaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally employed to treat various health issues, including inflammation, digestive problems, and skin conditions, due to its rich content of bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Rockrose include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it a valuable plant for the development of natural remedies and traditional medicine.
